content: संहारः .²1 Drawing or bringing together, collecting; अनुभवतु वेणीसंहारमहोत्सवम् <ls>Ve. 6</ls>; कृत्स्नं च धनसंहारं कुर्वन्ति विधिकारणात् <ls>Mb. 12. 20. 8</ls>. .²2 Contraction, compression, abridgment. .²3 Withholding, drawing back, withdrawal (<ab>opp.</ab> प्रयोग or विक्षेप); समर्थो धारणे मोक्षे संहारे चासि पाण्डव <ls>Mb. 3. 40. 15</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 7. 27</ls>; प्रयोगसंहारविभक्तमन्त्रम् <ls>R. 5. 57</ls>, <ls n="R. 5.">45</ls>. .²4 Restraining, holding back. .²5 Destruction, especially of the universe, universal destruction; संहारे समनुप्राप्ते व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः <ls>Rām. 7. 62. 5</ls>. .²6 Close, end, conclusion. .²7 An assemblage, a group. .²8 A fault in pronunciation. .²9 A charm or spell for withdrawing magical weapons. .²10 Practice, skill. .²11 A division of hell.
